What is a list comprehension and how is it different from a generator expression?

Supplied answer
A list comprehension [x*x for x in range(5)] builds the complete list in memory immediately. A generator
expression (x*x for x in range(5)) creates a lazy generator that produces one value at a time and can be
iterated only once. For large data the generator saves a lot of memory.
